D: A young inventor's machine makes food rain from the sky over his small island town.
P: Serve the mains when the first cheeseburgers start falling.
S: the island town that ran on sardines
Tinned sardines mashed with butter, lemon and parsley, spread on sourdough toast, finished with sliced radish and black pepper.
Beef sliders smashed thin on a hot griddle, American cheese melted on, pickles, onion and burger sauce on soft slider buns, stacked high on a platter.

Wobbly cubes of orange, raspberry and lime jelly made with real juice, stacked into a castle on a platter with whipped cream turrets. For each colour, soften 4 tsp gelatine in 3 tbsp cold water, then dissolve in 300ml warm juice with 2 tbsp sugar: orange juice, raspberry juice and lime cordial diluted with water. Pour each into its own lined loaf tin and chill 4 hours until firm. Cut into 3cm cubes and stack into a castle on a platter. Pipe whipped cream from 200ml cream on top.
M: the spaghetti tornado and the giant meatballs
Big beef and pork meatballs with soaked bread, parmesan and parsley, browned, simmered 45 minutes in tomato sauce with basil, over a twisting pile of spaghetti.
Steak storm garlic butter rump and fries

Rump steaks seared in a smoking pan, rested and sliced, topped with melting garlic and parsley butter, with shoestring fries salted straight from the oven. Mash 80g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves, chopped parsley and salt, roll into a log and chill. Bake 800g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Season 4 rump steaks of 200g and sear in a smoking pan, flipping every minute, for 6 to 8 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, slice and top with discs of garlic butter. Salt the fries and serve.
W: the snow day made of ice cream
Vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream scooped into a big snowy mountain, with sprinkles, wafer biscuits and hot fudge.
K: Layers of raspberry, orange and lime syrups in a glass, topped with lemonade so the colours run together.

s.note: the island town that ran on sardines
s.how: Mash 2 drained tins of sardines with 30g soft butter, lemon juice and chopped parsley. Spread on 8 slices toasted sourdough and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.
Smash 12 small patties from 500g beef mince on a hot griddle and melt American cheese on top. Put into slider buns with pickles, onion and burger sauce. Stack them high on a platter.

m.note: the spaghetti tornado and the giant meatballs
m.how: Mix 400g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 2 slices soaked bread, 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into 8 big balls and brown. Simmer 45 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with basil. Pile over 500g spaghetti.

w.note: the snow day made of ice cream
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream into a big mountain on a platter. Cover with sprinkles, stick in wafer biscuits and pour over the hot fudge.

d.how: Make three syrups: blitzed raspberries with sugar, orange juice with sugar, and lime juice with sugar. Spoon a layer of each into four tall glasses and top slowly with lemonade so the colours run together.
